/* PERSISTENT LIVE BALANCE MANAGEMENT FUNCTIONS SYSTEM */
function getUserBalance(username) {
const balanceKey = `smm_balance_${username}`;
let currentBalance = localStorage.getItem(balanceKey);
if (currentBalance === null) {
// Initialize default wallet capital to zero for new user registrations
localStorage.setItem(balanceKey, "0.00");
return 0.00;
}
return parseFloat(currentBalance);
}
function setUserBalance(username, amount) {
const balanceKey = `smm_balance_${username}`;
localStorage.setItem(balanceKey, parseFloat(amount).toFixed(2));
updateNavbarWalletDisplay();
}
function updateNavbarWalletDisplay() {
const loggedInUser = localStorage.getItem('smm_logged_user');
if (loggedInUser) {
const bal = getUserBalance(loggedInUser);
navWalletBalance.textContent = `₹${bal.toFixed(2)}`;
}
}
/* SCREEN MULTI-VIEW ROUTING TOGGLE ENGINE */
function switchMainView(targetView) {
if (targetView === 'order') {
orderViewWrapper.classList.add('active');
walletViewWrapper.classList.remove('active');
tabOrderView.classList.add('active');
tabWalletView.classList.remove('active');
} else if (targetView === 'wallet') {
orderViewWrapper.classList.remove('active');
walletViewWrapper.classList.add('active');
tabOrderView.classList.remove('active');
tabWalletView.classList.add('active');
}
}
/* MANUAL AUTHENTICATION & SESSION PERSISTENCE ENGINE */
function checkSessionState() {
const loggedInUser = localStorage.getItem('smm_logged_user');
if (loggedInUser) {
authBox.style.display = 'none';
appNavbar.style.display = 'ex';

appFloats.style.display = 'none';
}
}
function switchAuthTab(tab) {
const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.auth-tab');
const forms = document.querySelectorAll('.auth-form');
tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
forms.forEach(f => f.classList.remove('active'));
if (tab === 'login') {
tabs[0].classList.add('active');
document.getElementById('loginForm').classList.add('active');
} else {
tabs[1].classList.add('active');
document.getElementById('registerForm').classList.add('active');
}
}
function handleManualRegister(e) {
e.preventDefault();
const user = document.getElementById('regUser').value.trim();
const email = document.getElementById('regEmail').value.trim();
const pass = document.getElementById('regPass').value;
if (localStorage.getItem(`smm_user_${user}`)) {
showSystemModal('error', 'Registration Error', 'Username already exists inside system
registry.');
return;
}
const registrationData = { username: user, email: email, password: pass };
localStorage.setItem(`smm_user_${user}`, JSON.stringify(registrationData));
// Allocate initial balance index tracking for registered slot immediately
getUserBalance(user);
showSystemModal(
'success', 'Prole Initialized', 'Registration credentials wrien successfully.
Proceeding to login screen.');
e.target.reset();
switchAuthTab('login');
}
function handleManualLogin(event) {
event.preventDefault();
const user = document.getElementById('loginUser').value.trim();
const pass = document.getElementById('loginPass').value;
const savedProleRecord = localStorage.getItem(`smm_user_${user}`);
if (!savedProleRecord) {
showSystemModal('error', 'Authentication Failed', 'Provided entry record could not be
mapped to an active account.');
return;
}
const userObj = JSON.parse(savedProleRecord);
if (userObj.password === pass) {
localStorage.setItem('smm_logged_user', userObj.username);
showSystemModal('success', 'Access Authorized', 'Workspace prole handshake complete.
Loading dashboard interface parameters.');
setTimeout(() => {
closeSystemModal();
checkSessionState();
},
1000);
} else {
showSystemModal('error', 'Validation Denied', 'Security signature keys do not match
account parameters values.');
}
}
function handleManualLogout() {
localStorage.removeItem('smm_logged_user');
showSystemModal('success', 'Session Terminated', 'Logged out successfully. Re-routing to
entry authentication module view.');
setTimeout(() => {
closeSystemModal();
checkSessionState();
},
1000);
}

function renderServices(lterQuery = "") {
const selectedCategory = categorySelect.value;

serviceSelect.innerHTML =
"";

ltered.forEach(srv => {

handleServiceSelectionChange(ltered[
0].id);

function handleServiceSelectionChange(serviceId) {

</div>
`
;

(${currentService.linkType})`;

maxLimitText.textContent = `Max Order Volume: ${currentService.max.toLocaleString()}`;

maxLimitText.textContent = "Max Order Count: --";
avgTimeText.textContent = "--";
chargeText.textContent = "₹0.00";
}
function calculateLiveCharge() {
if(!selectedServiceGlobal) {
chargeText.textContent = "₹0.00";
return;
}
const quantity = parseInt(quantityInput.value) || 0;
const computedCharge = (quantity / 1000) * selectedServiceGlobal.rate;
chargeText.textContent = `₹${computedCharge.toFixed(2)}`;
}
function showSystemModal(type, title, desc, customHtml = "") {
const modalContent = document.getElementById('modalContent');
let iconMarkup = "";
if(type === 'success') {
iconMarkup = `<div class="modal-icon success"><i class="fa-solid
fa-circle-check"></i></div>`;
} else if(type === 'error') {
iconMarkup = `<div class="modal-icon error"><i class="fa-solid
fa-triangle-exclamation"></i></div>`;
} else {
iconMarkup = `<div class="modal-icon oer"><i class="fa-solid
fa-re-ame-curved"></i></div>`;
}
modalContent.innerHTML =
`
${iconMarkup}
<div class="modal-title">${title}</div>
<div class="modal-desc">${desc}</div>
${customHtml}
<buon type="buon" class="btn-modal-close" onclick="closeSystemModal()">Close
Details</buon>
`
;
modalOverlay.classList.add('active');
}
function closeSystemModal() {
modalOverlay.classList.remove('active');
}
// Event Hook Bindings Systems
categorySelect.addEventListener('change', () => {
searchService.value = "";
renderServices();
});
serviceSelect.addEventListener(
'change', (e) => {
handleServiceSelectionChange(e.target.value);
});
searchService.addEventListener(
'input', (e) => {
renderServices(e.target.value);
});
quantityInput.addEventListener(
'input', calculateLiveCharge);
/* SUBMIT ACTION 1: PLACING NEW ORDER (WITH LIVE DEDUCTION LOGIC) */
smmOrderForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
e.preventDefault();
const activeSessionUser = localStorage.getItem('smm_logged_user');
if(!activeSessionUser) return;
if(!selectedServiceGlobal) {
showSystemModal('error', 'Selection Required', 'Please assign an active marketing pipeline
before conrming.');
return;
}
const linkVal = linkInput.value.trim();
const qtyVal = parseInt(quantityInput.value) || 0;
const absoluteCalculatedCost = parseFloat(((qtyVal / 1000) *
selectedServiceGlobal.rate).toFixed(2));
const currentWalletCapital = getUserBalance(activeSessionUser);
if(!linkVal) {
showSystemModal('error', 'Empty Input Reference', 'The destination link target URL cannot
remain blank.');
return;
}
if(qtyVal < selectedServiceGlobal.min || qtyVal > selectedServiceGlobal.max) {
showSystemModal('error', 'Volume Limits Violation', `Quantity bound criteria error. Allowed
volume parameters range between ${selectedServiceGlobal.min} and
${selectedServiceGlobal.max} units.`);
return;
}
/* ACCOUNT WALLET BALANCE SUFFICIENCY VERIFICATION INJECTION CHECK */
if (currentWalletCapital < absoluteCalculatedCost) {
showSystemModal('error', 'Insucient Funds (Paise Kam Hain)', `Your balance is
₹${currentWalletCapital.toFixed(2)}, but this order costs
₹${absoluteCalculatedCost.toFixed(2)}.<br><br>Please navigate to the <b>Add Funds (Mani
Add)</b> tab to recharge your wallet account instantly.`);
return;
}
// Deduct the calculated service cost from client memory store structure immediately
const updatedWalletCapital = currentWalletCapital - absoluteCalculatedCost;
setUserBalance(activeSessionUser, updatedWalletCapital);
const uniqueTimestamp = Date.now();
const orderIdGenerated = `NEX${uniqueTimestamp}`;
const currentDateTimeString = new Date().toLocaleString();
// Setup programmatic payload eld elements bindings parameters
document.getElementById('payload_order_id').value = orderIdGenerated;
document.getElementById('payload_user_session').value = activeSessionUser;
document.getElementById('payload_category').value = categorySelect.value;
document.getElementById('payload_service_name').value = selectedServiceGlobal.name;
document.getElementById('payload_service_id').value = selectedServiceGlobal.id;
document.getElementById('payload_link').value = linkVal;
document.getElementById('payload_quantity').value = qtyVal;
document.getElementById('payload_charge').value =
`₹${absoluteCalculatedCost.toFixed(2)}`;
document.getElementById('payload_balance_remaining').value =
`₹${updatedWalletCapital.toFixed(2)}`;
document.getElementById('payload_avg_time').value = selectedServiceGlobal.time;
document.getElementById('payload_datetime').value = currentDateTimeString;
document.getElementById('fs_subject').value = `New Order Placed By [${activeSessionUser}]
- ID: [${orderIdGenerated}]`;
showSystemModal('success', 'Order Placed & Money Deducted', `Order trace tag created:
<b>${orderIdGenerated}</b>.<br>Cost: ₹${absoluteCalculatedCost.toFixed(2)} has been deducted
from your account.<br>Remaining Balance:
<b>₹${updatedWalletCapital.toFixed(2)}</b>.<br><br>Routing dispatch payload record parameters
to execution servers...`);
setTimeout(() => {
smmOrderForm.submit();
}, 2000);
});
/* SUBMIT ACTION 2: ADD FUNDS (MANI ADD REQUEST LOGIC WITH SIMULATION UPDATE) */
walletDepositForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
e.preventDefault();
const activeSessionUser = localStorage.getItem('smm_logged_user');
if(!activeSessionUser) return;
const fundingAmountValue =
parseFloat(document.getElementById('depositAmountInput').value) || 0;
const transactionUtrCode = document.getElementById('depositUtrInput').value.trim();
if (fundingAmountValue <= 0) {
showSystemModal('error', 'Invalid Sum', 'Deposit metrics valuation must scale above zero
rupees.');
return;
}
if (transactionUtrCode.length < 12) {
showSystemModal('error', 'Invalid Identication Key', 'The UPI UTR code sequence tracking
code must consist of at least a 12 digit format structure.');
return;
}
const currentBalanceBeforeAction = getUserBalance(activeSessionUser);
// Simulate instant balance allocation updating inside client memory prole stack context
const theoreticalUpdatedBalanceSum = currentBalanceBeforeAction + fundingAmountValue;
setUserBalance(activeSessionUser, theoreticalUpdatedBalanceSum);
const depositTimestampId = `DEP${Date.now()}`;
const executionDateTimeString = new Date().toLocaleString();
// Congure FormSubmit payload components before posting values
document.getElementById('payload_deposit_id').value = depositTimestampId;
document.getElementById('payload_deposit_user').value = activeSessionUser;
document.getElementById('payload_prev_balance').value =
`₹${currentBalanceBeforeAction.toFixed(2)}`;
document.getElementById('payload_new_balance').value =
`₹${theoreticalUpdatedBalanceSum.toFixed(2)}`;
document.getElementById('payload_deposit_time').value = executionDateTimeString;
document.getElementById('fs_wallet_subject').value = `Deposit Verication Request
[${depositTimestampId}] From User: ${activeSessionUser}`;
showSystemModal('success', 'Mani Add Verication Request Filed', `Deposit identication
reference: <b>${depositTimestampId}</b>.<br>Amount: ₹${fundingAmountValue.toFixed(2)} added
to your active display stack.<br><br>Your wallet display updates to:
<b>₹${theoreticalUpdatedBalanceSum.toFixed(2)}</b>.<br><br>The transaction data index blocks
are transferring to verication nodes...`);
setTimeout(() => {
walletDepositForm.submit();
}, 2500);
});
oersBtn.addEventListener(
'click', () => {
const oersHtml = `
<div class="oers-list">
<div class="oer-item"><i class="fa-solid fa-gi"></i> <span><b>Welcome Wallet
Incentive:</b> Deposit threshold orders scaling above ₹2,000 gain priority status queues
routes.</span></div>
<div class="oer-item"><i class="fa-solid fa-lightning-bolt"></i> <span><b>Instagram Reel
Engine Updates:</b> Highly ecient node infrastructure speed parameters maximized across
category indices items.</span></div>
</div>
`;
showSystemModal('oer', 'Active SMMNEXUS System Incentives', 'Live operational updates
tracking modications loops conguration tables properties.', oersHtml);
});
modalOverlay.addEventListener(
'click', function(e) {
if(e.target === modalOverlay) {
closeSystemModal();
}
});
// Initialize core application framework lifecycle scripts
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
checkSessionState();
initCategoryDropdown();
renderServices();
});
</
script>
</body>
</html>
